keys.DOTA_Survivors_PatchNotes_1_1_Abilities_: Proximity Mines: Base Cooldown reduced from 5s to 4s.
Proximity Mines: Reworked Aghanim's Scepter: Lower cooldown by 20%. Now have a chance to plant Stasis Traps (lower damage, applies stun) and Remote Mines (higher damage, no trigger time).
Knife Throw: Cooldown Scaling changed to reduce cooldown by a flat 0.3s at odd levels. (Cooldown is 0 at max level)
Knife Throw: Pierce scaling changed to give 1 additional pierce at levels 3 and 5.
Knife Throw: Reworked Scepter: Knives now have infinite pierce.
Spirits: Reworked Scepter: Spirits now trigger explosions upon impact.
Counter Helix: Aghanim's Scepter: Internal cooldown increased from 0.05s to 0.15s.
Counter Helix: Base damage increased from 20 to 25.
Counter Helix: Damage Scaling per level increased from 10 to 15.
Mortimer's Kisses: Base damage increased from 5 to 6.
Mortimer's Kisses: Damage scaling per level increased from 3 to 4.
Frostbite: Base Target Count increased from 1 to 2.
Frostbite: Target Count scaling at levels 2 and 6 increased from 1 to 2.
Magic Missile: Aghanim's Scepter: Decreased damage gained per kill from 0.04 to 0.035.
Vengeful Spirit's Innate Unending Terror: Increased damage physical resistance reduction from 20% to 30%.
keys.DOTA_Survivors_PatchNotes_1_1_Items_001: Octarine Core: Cooldown Reduction Multiplier reduced from 6% to 5% per level.
keys.DOTA_Survivors_PatchNotes_1_1_Items_002: Timeless Relic: Max level lowered from 3 to 2.
keys.DOTA_Survivors_PatchNotes_1_1_Other_001: The player now has a green glow around them to help with visibility.
keys.DOTA_Survivors_PatchNotes_1_1_Other_002: Vases during the Imperia fight now always have a guaranteed cheese.
keys.DOTA_Survivors_PatchNotes_1_1_Other_003: Fix pickups occasionally dropping outside of the world.
keys.DOTA_Survivors_PatchNotes_1_1_Other_004: Knockback from projectiles now always go in the direction of the projectile's velocity upon impact.
keys.DOTA_Survivors_PatchNotes_1_1_Other_005: Fix not correctly showing all available level up or item choices when there were 3 or less available choices.
keys.DOTA_Survivors_PatchNotes_1_1_Other_006: Fix collision indicator on Wailing Mass not being correctly aligned.

keys.DOTA_Survivors_ToggleFilterTokenTooltip: Toggle to enable/disable filtering by required tokens during hero pick.
